title: Some thoughts on collective consciousness
content: I was watching a clip on collective consciousness and how our brains don’t work in a vacuum meaning, without each other’s input, we would not be completely conscious. My brain works because someone else’s thoughts/actions are contributing to my thoughts. We share energies without even knowing it, and perhaps this is where our connections come from; we are sharing our energies and when we are no longer conscious of our thoughts, they begin to meet up together, to find a balance. This is conjecture and obviously not a certainty, but I think there is definitely something to be considered.
